caption: The drawing features a wrought iron door, rendered in black ink on a light beige or off-white background. The door consists of three rectangular panels, each filled with intricate, symmetrical scrollwork and geometric patterns, prominently using curves, spirals, and triangular forms within a rectangular frame. The ironwork appears ornate and dense, with repeated motifs forming a decorative lattice. The door is set within a simple rectangular doorway, which is shaded to suggest a stone or stucco wall. Above the door, crosshatching and linear shading indicate architectural detailing at the top of the frame. The caption "WROUGHT IRON DOOR" is written in capital letters below the door in a clear serif font. The drawing uses controlled linework and stippling to create texture and depth within the composition.
title: Wrought Iron Door
